items.q: Joe Smith, that wonderful trumpet player, and Coleman Hawkins and Don Redman and Buster Bailey on the clarinet. Oh, we just loved this band, you know.

ctx.x: You know, we all used to listen to Henderson records, and you know, it sounded all very exciting. Joe Smith, that wonderful trumpet player, and Coleman Hawkins and Don Redman and Buster Bailey on the clarinet. Oh, we just loved this band, you know. Everybody wanted to play with Fletcher Henderson.
